title: SAP Sales Process Atlas
purpose: A memory-first, source-tracked map of standard and special sales process variants, their control points, data hinges, consequences, constraints, and extension surfaces.

code_system.rule: The code is ours and stays stable even if SAP renames a scope item or app. SAP scope-item IDs remain external references, not primary keys.

questions: Which documents or stock segments appear?
Which data fields become hinges for the next step?
What is different in accounting, inventory, delivery, or billing?
What breaks first when the design is wrong?
Where can the process be extended without rewriting the core?

extension_surfaces.title: Custom logic and BAdIs
extension_surfaces.memory_hook: Use a defined hook, not an invisible side effect.

extension_surfaces.title: APIs and integration contracts
extension_surfaces.memory_hook: The integration boundary is part of the process design.

extension_surfaces.title: Reference and copy-control logic
extension_surfaces.memory_hook: A follow-on document inherits rules, not just fields.

extension_surfaces.title: Side-by-side capabilities
extension_surfaces.memory_hook: Keep orchestration outside the core when ownership sits outside the ERP transaction.
